widgets_values:
[0s–4s] Medium shot, she moves fluidly to the beat, hair swinging with her
movement, colored strobe light sweeping across her face and body in rhythm.

[4s–8s] Camera circles slowly around her as she dances, other dancers blurred and
out of focus around her, she remains the sharp focal point, lights flashing in
sync with the music's rhythm.

[8s–12s] Close-up on her face, eyes closed, lost in the moment, lights flaring
and pulsing behind her, hair catching the light as she moves.

Style: high-energy nightclub cinematography, saturated colored lighting (magenta,
cyan, deep blue), lens flare and light streaks, shallow depth of field isolating
her from the crowd, confident and immersive dance energy.

Audio: pulsing club music/bass, ambient crowd noise, energetic and rhythmic
throughout.

nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## Switches

**First Frame ON / OFF**  (node 381)
**Last Frame ON / OFF**  (node 78)

| First Frame | Last Frame | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| ON | ON | First + last frame |
| ON | OFF | Image to video |
| OFF | OFF | **Text to video** |

Both image inputs are optional. Turn both off and the
model generates from the prompt alone (t2va).

**Stage 2 ON / OFF**  (node 315)
ON  = FL2VA resample upscale at Stage 2 Resolution
OFF = Stage 1 output only

## Notes

Model: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot
MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo is the t2va / fl2va node, so it
needs fl2va weights - not ref2va.

Stage 1 and Stage 2 can use different resolutions
because Stage 2 re-encodes the keyframes at its own
resolution (node 380). Unlike ref2va, fl2va keyframe
rows are pinned to the target grid, so conditioning
cannot be shared between the two stages. Both stages
must use the same frame count (node 56).
